explanation: The two ants walk into each other, collide once, reverse, and then walk off opposite ends. The maximum is 1, and both ants achieve it, so both indices follow.

Ant 1 meets ant 2 first; both reverse. Ant 1 (now moving left) then meets ant 0 (still moving right); both reverse again. Ant 1 is involved in both collisions, while ants 0 and 2 have one each. The maximum is 2, achieved only by ant 1.
Every ant walks away from the others, so nobody ever collides. The maximum is 0 and all four ants achieve it.
